CamNet Customer Support portal: adding a portal user

Prepared by Great Blue, 2026-10-27. Tested in the CamNet sandbox and production. Red outlines mark what to click or check.

What went wrong

The test portal user (David Drescher) was given the profile "Customer Community User". That profile does not have access to the Customer Support site, so Salesforce did not add the user to the site, did not send a usable invite, and does not offer a password reset. The fix is to use the site's own profile: "CamNet Support Community User".

Before you start: the customer's account needs a Primary Contract

When a portal user opens a ticket, Salesforce creates a Work Order using the Primary Contract on their company's Account. If that field is blank, the ticket fails with "Please specify a Service Contract". Before giving anyone portal access, open their Account and set Primary Contract to the customer's active service contract.

Walkthrough 1: fix a user who has the wrong profile

Walkthrough 2: add a new portal user the right way

Step 2. On the New User form:

  • User License: "Customer Community" (or "Customer Community Login").
  • Profile: "CamNet Support Community User" (or "CamNet Support Community Login User" with the Login license). Do not use the default "Customer Community User", "Customer Community Login User" or "Customer Community Plus User" profiles. Salesforce blocks them with a message.
  • Email and Username: the person's email address.
  • Select "Generate new password and notify user immediately", then click Save.

Step 3. The person gets the welcome email, sets a password, and logs in at https://camnet.my.site.com/customersupport. To check what they see, use Log in to Experience as User on the Contact.

Walkthrough 3: set up a manager (sees all of their company's tickets)

Managers need the Customer Community Plus license. Start from a working portal user (Walkthrough 1 or 2), then open their user record in Setup and click Edit.

Step 2. Click Edit again. Set Role to the role ending in "Manager" for their company, then click Save. If the Role list is empty, save once more and reopen Edit; Salesforce creates the company's roles when its first Plus user is saved.

Step 3. Setup > Public Groups > Camnet Support Community Managers > Edit. Set Search to Customer Portal Users, add the user, and click Save.

Plus seats are limited. Check Setup > Company Information > User Licenses for free Customer Community Plus seats before adding a manager. To remove manager access, take the user out of the group and change the license back to Customer Community with the "CamNet Support Community User" profile.

If someone cannot log in

Open their user record. If you see "This user isn't a member of any Experience Cloud site", the profile is wrong. Do Walkthrough 1.

If a ticket fails to submit

If the error mentions "Please specify a Service Contract", the customer's Account has no Primary Contract. Set it on the Account and submit the ticket again.
